pool.concept: A rain-soaked traveler in the glass waiting room of an island ferry terminal carefully lifting a wet boarding pass from the sill as the ferry lights emerge in rain.
A rain-soaked traveler under a coastal bus shelter uses a dry corner of her travel folder to rescue a curled paper ticket while the bus headlamps approach.
A traveler caught by a sudden downpour at a rural train platform slides her wet suitcase under a roof and catches the soaked baggage ribbon before it drips onto her ticket.
At a small harbor ticket hatch, a traveler arriving out of rain presses a wind-lifted ferry receipt under a brass coin while sheltering its dry half with her travel folder.
